sources.snippet: Intended use and limitations Xevn is built for decisions: classification, multiple choice, yes/no judgments, and rating. It is not a chat or text-generation model. It is tuned for Korean; English input works but is not the focus. Xevn returns probabilities over the options you give it. It does not generate text and cannot answer open questions.
